name: PPSC Past Papers all MCQs 2022 of Basic Mathematics

mcqs.question: Which Muslim scientist wrote the first book on Algebra and is known as the Father of Algebra?
If A and B together can complete a piece of work in 15 days and B alone in 20 days, then in how many days can A alone complete the work?
If there are 27 students in class and 7 girls are more than boys. How many total girls are in class?
A and B together can complete a work in 3 days. They start together but after 2 days, B left the work. If the work is completed after two more days, B alone could do the work in ____?

A school has only four classes that contain 10, 20, 30, and 40 students respectively. The pass percentage of these classes are 20%, 30%, 60%, and 100% respectively. Find the pass % of the entire school.
One Kilometer is equal to ______ metres.
Total number of students in a class is 95. If the total numberon girls in the class is 45, then the ratio of total number of boys to total number of girls is?
x, 9, 25, 48, 81, 121 find the value of x?
1/2 inch is equal to 12 kilometers the distance between two points is 5-2/3 inches. What is the distance in kilometers?
If a * b = a + b + ab, then 3 * 4 - 2 * 3 is equal to?
Find the number of triangles which can be formed by joining the angular points of a polygon of 8 sides as vertices.
How many times in a day are the hands of clock in straight line but opposite in direction?
The ratio of the length of a rod and its shadow is 1: √3. The angle of elevation of the sun is _____?
In how many ways 2 students can be chosen from the class of 20 students?
A fort had provision of food for 150 men for 45 days. After 10 days, 25 men left the fort. The number of days for which the remaining food will last, is?
There are 56 boys in a class of 140 students. What is the percentage of boys?
The average of the first five multiples of 9 is _____?
A batsman in his 12th inning makes a score of 80 runs and thereby increase his average score by 3. what is his average after the 12th inning?
